section.title: Stash
section.p: Opens a drop-down menu for creating a stash or listing existing stashes.

dlentry.dd: Use a stash when you need a clean working copy and want to reapply the changes later.

section.title: Stash Changes
section.p: Creates a new stash from the changed files in the working copy.

dlentry.dd: Stash drop-down menu, Ellipsis menu, and Git menu.
Changed files in the current working copy.

section.title: List Stashes
section.p: Opens a dialog box that lists existing stashes.

dlentry.dd: Stash drop-down menu, Ellipsis menu, and Git menu.
You can apply or remove a stash.

section.title: Apply Stash
section.p: Applies a selected stash to the working copy.

dlentry.dd: The selected stash and the current working copy.

section.title: Remove Stash
section.p: Deletes a selected stash from the stash list.

dlentry.dd: Remove a stash only when you no longer need the saved changes.

section.title: Submodule
section.p: Opens a control where you can select a submodule to open and work with.

dlentry.dd: Enabled when the repository contains submodules.
When you clone a repository with submodules, the Git Client initializes and clones the submodules.

section.title: Open Submodule
section.p: Opens the selected submodule so you can work with it as a repository.

dlentry.dd: Submodule control, or the Open contextual menu action for a modified submodule in the Unstaged files area.
